description: Inspect assets, nodes, accounts, users, permissions, and sessions through an official JumpServer MCP server.

fields.label: MCP SSE Endpoint
fields.description: The SSE endpoint exposed by the official jumpserver/mcp server. Its default path is /sse. Public HTTPS endpoints are supported by default. Private-network, Tailscale, and NetBird endpoints require OOMOL_CONNECT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK. Loopback endpoints remain blocked. See https://github.com/jumpserver/mcp.

fields.label: JumpServer Bearer Token
fields.description: A JumpServer API Bearer token forwarded by jumpserver/mcp to the JumpServer API. If the MCP server enables api_key, configure it to accept this same token.

actions.name: accounts_accounts_list
actions.description: List managed accounts visible to the configured JumpServer token.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

offset.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.

search.description: Search text applied to fields supported by this JumpServer resource.

inputSchema.description: Common JumpServer list filters. Availability of matching records depends on the Bearer token permissions.

anyOf.description: URL for the next page when one exists.

next.description: URL for the next page when one exists.

anyOf.description: URL for the previous page when one exists.

previous.description: URL for the previous page when one exists.

outputSchema.description: A paginated list of JumpServer managed accounts.
